name: quickbooks-desktop
description: Ask questions about your QuickBooks Desktop company file and, if you allow it, make safe changes.
long_description: Connects Claude to QuickBooks Desktop (Pro, Premier or Enterprise) on this Windows computer. Read-only by default: customers, vendors, items, invoices, bills, reports and more. Turn on writes only when you want them. Before first use, open the company file in QuickBooks as an admin and run the server once with --authorize to allow access.

company_file.title: Company file
company_file.description: The QuickBooks company file (.qbw). Leave empty to use whichever file is open in QuickBooks.

allow_writes.title: Allow changes
allow_writes.description: Let Claude create, update, delete and void records. Off means read-only.

allow_payroll.title: Allow payroll data
allow_payroll.description: Let Claude see employee payroll details and payroll reports.

redact.title: Hide tax IDs and bank and card numbers
redact.description: Mask sensitive numbers in everything Claude sees. Recommended.
